opening.argument: The video’s central argument is a market forecast, not a guaranteed return. The speaker proposes that Bitcoin and XRP may reach a bottom between May and October, explains the May estimate through historical moving-average analysis, and ties October to the duration of a prior bear market. The Coin Depot promotion is part of the record: the speaker describes earning interest on crypto, and the description discloses that links may generate a commission. It also warns that crypto-assets carry substantial risk and expressly says profits and outcomes are not guaranteed. Optimism about buying near a bottom and interest on crypto do not, on this record, establish deceptive solicitation.
